title: KDFlow: A User-Friendly and Efficient Knowledge Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.01875v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to compress and post-train large language models (LLMs), yet many existing frameworks execute teacher inference with the same training-oriented backend as student optimization, leading to suboptimal efficiency. In this paper, we propose KDFlow, a novel framework for LLM distillation that features a decoupled architecture and employs SGLang for teacher inference. KDFlow combines SGLang for teacher inference with PyTorch FSDP2 for student optimization, allowing each model to run on a backend tailored to its workload. To enable efficient full-vocabulary distillation in this decoupled architecture, KDFlow transfers the teacher's final hidden states via Ray's object store and recomputes teacher logits on each student worker using a frozen copy of the teacher's output head. translated_title: KDFlow：一个面向大语言模型的用户友好且高效的知识蒸馏框架
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏（KD）被广泛用于压缩和后训练大语言模型（LLM），然而许多现有框架使用与Student优化相同的面向训练的后端来执行Teacher推理，导致效率欠佳。在本文中，我们提出了KDFlow，一个新颖的LLM蒸馏框架，其特点是采用解耦架构并使用SGLang进行Teacher推理。KDFlow将用于Teacher推理的SGLang与用于Student优化的PyTorch FSDP2相结合，使每个模型都能在适合其工作负载的后端上运行。为了在这种解耦架构下实现高效的全词表蒸馏，KDFlow通过Ray的对象存储传输Teacher的最终隐藏状态，并使用Teacher输出头的冻结副本在每个Student工作节点上重新计算Teacher的logits。此外，我们的框架同时支持离策略和在线蒸馏，并融合了跨分词器算法……
tldr: KDFlow提出了一种解耦架构的大语言模型知识蒸馏框架，结合SGLang进行Teacher推理与PyTorch FSDP2进行Student优化，并通过Ray对象存储传输Teacher隐藏状态、在Student端重算Teacher logits来实现高效的全词表蒸馏。
en_tdlr: KDFlow is a decoupled-architecture knowledge distillation framework for LLMs that combines SGLang for teacher inference with PyTorch FSDP2 for student optimization, enabling efficient full-vocabulary distillation by transferring teacher hidden states via Ray's object store and recomputing teacher logits on student workers.
